title: Beltrunners - an EVE-inspired mining/combat prototype I can't stop working on (browser-based, retro pixel art, looking for feedback)
author: Former_Ideal8931
selftext:
Hey everyone, this is my first post after months of doom-scrolling r/gamedev, r/solodev, and r/aigamedev.

A bit of background: I studied game development but ended up in an IT career instead, while still being pretty passionate about making games on the side. I've built a lot of prototypes over the years, but none of them stuck - until this one. With Claude Code, I finally have both the time and the motivation to actually build the things that have been sitting in the back of my head, and Beltrunners is the first prototype that's kept pulling me back every free minute I get.

**What is it?**  
Beltrunners takes a lot of what I love about EVE Online: mining, PVE combat, a player-driven economy, shared galaxies but strips away everything that makes EVE exhausting to keep up with. For now there is no PVP, no fleets to coordinate and no politics. Just the parts that make spreadsheet-in-space feel satisfying: fighting off pirates, hunting for the perfect ship and loadout fit for how you want to play, beating the market, all wrapped in a retro pixel art look I know a lot of us still love.

**Why I'm posting this**  
Honestly, I was on the fence about sharing it at all. But the feedback from friends who tried it has been genuinely positive, and it pushed me to keep going. What I've realized along the way is that sharing and talking about the game is actually a big part of what I enjoy about this whole process. Probably as much as building it.

Because it's browser-based, I can push new builds constantly, so this doesn't have to be a one-and-done post. I'd love to make this an ongoing conversation: below the game, I've added a space where you can drop feature ideas directly and upvote the ones other people suggest.

I would be more than happy of you try it out: [https://beltrunners.vercel.app/](https://beltrunners.vercel.app/)

**Last words**  
This is a very early build. I've been pouring my time into the core, game-defining features rather than the polish around the edges, so things like account management, sign-up emails, and general UX are very rough.

comments.author: Dreamt_Up_Games
comments.body: I can’t try it out right now but I’ve always thought that a top down eve inspired game would be cool. Good luck!

replies.author: Former_Ideal8931
replies.body: Yeah, there's magic in EVE that I hope to transport with this game as well. The game is not going away anytime soon - happy to get your feedback and ideas in the future! Take care!

comments.body:
I see EVE in this sub, I upvote!  

Nice to see the ship spins when docked ;p  
Tried to mine some ore, Carebear success.   
Tried to sell the ores, did not succeed (no NPC buyers?)  
Noticed Miner Mk I/II have player names (player sellers?!)  
Made an account without issue :)

GL with the project!

replies.author: Former_Ideal8931
replies.body:
Ha! o7 Fellow Capsuleer! And yes, you're spot on! Marker is 100% Player Driven. All ores will be bought by other pilots. Of course the economy is lacking at the moment as there is not a big enough player base and not too many tools/weapons to build - but it's all on the roadmap!

Fly safe and thanks for stopping by, o7

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
Oh cool. That's ambitious! But I like it :)  
I think there was just an issue then maybe with listing my ore, that or I just failed to figure it out. 

As a former CCP dev (mweheh) I am glad you decided to not sit on the fence and share it instead, you should do it more regularly! I would like to see how it progresses <3

replies.author: Former_Ideal8931
replies.body:
This feedback is one of the reasons I love this community. Positive affirmation for our biggest passion! And so exciting to be a part of Eve Online's dev history! I think Eve Online is such an interesting and unique concept from a game dev perspective. 

Thank you and fly safe, o7

replies.author: Former_Ideal8931
replies.body:
Hey there! Thanks for stopping by! The game is in early dev and account management is rough around the edges. Need to setup my own SFTP to bypass the Supabase rate limit for sign ups if too many people sign up in a short period of time (which luckily has happened yesterday)

You can enjoy the full game without creating an account - I will send an update once the rate limit issue is solved though.

Fly safe o7

replies.author: Former_Ideal8931
